title: [Bug Fix] #638815: Subcontracting: actionable error for blank Subc. Location Code on WIP transfers
summary: The subcontracting transfer order report now raises a clear validation error when the subcontractor has no Subc. Location Code configured for WIP transfers, instead of showing a generic unhelpful message.
key_points: Replaces silent failure with actionable TestField error on blank Subc. Location Code
WIP transfer path now validates the location code consistently with the components path
Users get immediate feedback about the misconfigured vendor rather than a generic error at the end of the workflow
Regression test added to prevent recurrence of the generic error scenario
